div.span:
The amplifier delivers about 12–15 dBm at 0 dB attenuation. Switching to the termination first would dump that into the switch's 50 Ω resistor.
So: attenuate fully before terminating, and route before releasing the attenuator.

div.div: Between sweeps the source stays PARKED and running: stable temperature, fast retune, no repeated power-up.
